title: Welcome to Module 3: Capo, Minor Chords & Up Strums
summary: This beginner-oriented module focuses on rhythm as a core guitar skill while expanding chord vocabulary with minor and E minor. It introduces capos as a practical tool for staying in time with original recordings and for adjusting song keys to suit a singer’s range. The instructor frames the lesson around two new chords (minor and E minor), reinforces the importance of solid strumming and timing, and touches on the typical beginner pain timeline as practice continues. The transcript indicates an emphasis on rhythm over perfect chord accuracy and sets the stage for applying capoed transpositions and new chord shapes in subsequent lessons.
